meta.name: ulw-execute
meta.description: Executes a written ulw-plan work plan with Boulder state, evidence ledger, worktree discipline, and parallel subagents. Use when the user says ulw-execute or asks to run a .omo/plans plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把写好的开发计划自动执行完,留下改动证据与独立工作副本。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果已把开发计划写成文件,想让它被稳妥地自动执行。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your dev plan is already written down and you want it carried out automatically.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 不再自己写代码:它只挑计划、拆任务,把实现、测试和审查派给并行子代理,并记录进度与证据,直到 .omo/plans 计划里的复选框全部完成。
howto.when: 当你说 ulw-execute,或要求运行 .omo/plans 下的计划时接管;若没有可用计划,会先调用 ulw-plan 生成计划再执行。

say.note: 从 .omo/plans 里选中该计划并开始执行
每个阶段的工作以 PR 形式交付
无计划时先跑 ulw-plan 生成计划

howto.what_en: Claude stops writing code itself: it only picks the plan, splits tasks, delegates implementation, tests and review to parallel subagents, and records progress and evidence until every checkbox in the .omo/plans plan is complete.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say ulw-execute or ask to run a plan under .omo/plans; if no usable plan exists, it first invokes ulw-plan to create one.

say_en.note: Selects that plan under .omo/plans and starts executing
Each phase's work is delivered as a PR
With no plan, runs ulw-plan first
